Team — attaching the MAP v3 I reviewed with Sam and Claire this morning. Two things we need to lock before we push to DocuSign: the exec approval cadence (who signs when) and the onboarding start-slot so SRE can reserve capacity.

Quick summary of outstanding items: 
- Exec approvals: Sam wants a single exec signoff (Head of Ops) + procurement signature. Legal (aditya) needs to sign off on the indemnity clause in section 4.2.
- Signature timing: BrightRetail prefers signatures the week of May 3; they can do a Tue/Thu window if that helps internal approvers.
- Start date: customer asked for activation the following Monday after signature (preferred May 10). We need to confirm capacity & an internal go/no-go by Friday May 7 EOD.

Asks: aditya — can you review 4.2 and confirm whether we can accept the proposed language or we need redlines (I circled the paragraph in the attached). Priyom — can you confirm the internal SRE/Onboarding slot availability for May 10 and whether we can commit contingent on final signatures?

Attachments: BrightRetail-MAP-v3.pdf, SOW-BrightRetail-2027.docx

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop

Lauren — thanks for the flag. I read section 4.2 and proposed two narrow redlines (attached in-line in the PDF); both are aimed at limiting broad indemnity to third-party IP claims and clarifying data scoping. Neither should materially derail the commercial terms but they will need BrightRetail acceptance.

Operational note: if they accept our changes by EOD May 4, legal can clear the DocuSign envelope on May 5 which still fits their Tue/Thu window the week of May 3 (we'd target the Thu May 6 signer slot for exec + procurement). If BrightRetail insists on an alternate indemnity, that pushes the internal go/no-go to May 6.

I can join a short call with their legal team on May 3 AM if helpful.

Sam / Claire — thanks for the quick turn. To confirm next steps and timeline (final):

1) Legal: Aditya has proposed narrow redlines to section 4.2 and expects to clear by May 4 if procurement accepts; Aditya is available for a 20-minute call with procurement on May 3 10:00 AM PT.
2) Signatures: BrightRetail prefers Thu May 6; Redwood will open DocuSign envelope on Wed May 5 so signatures can occur Thu May 6 morning PT.
3) SLA credit: Redwood accepts the 60-day SLA credit window (agreed by engineering) — this will be reflected in the SOW revision (attached).
4) Internal go/no-go: Redwood needs a final internal approval (legal + product + ops) by EOD Fri May 7. Priyom will confirm SRE hard allocation then.
5) Start date: assuming sign on May 6, we confirm onboarding start slot Mon May 10 with an onboarding kickoff call scheduled for Fri May 7 09:00 AM PT (security handoff + playbook review).

Action items: 
- Claire / procurement: accept the small indemnity edits in 4.2 by EOD May 4 or send alternate language for Aditya to review.
- Sam: confirm Thu May 6 AM signer availability.
- Aditya: join procurement call May 3 10:00 AM PT (if requested).
- Priyom: confirm hard SRE allocation by May 7 EOD and send calendar holds for May 7 kickoff and May 10 onboarding.

I've attached the updated SOW and a signature grid (Signature-Grid.xlsx) with proposed signers and timing. If we get all green by May 4, I will open DocuSign on May 5 and tag Claire and the exec signer for May 6.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out cleanly.
